subject.title: fix: recover stuck Control UI chat runs

question: Should maintainers reimplement and prove this watchdog on the current split Control UI chat path, waive proof, or pause the replacement PR while keeping issue #42213 open?
rationale: Automation cannot safely settle the remaining choice because the current branch is stale/dirty and the proof gate needs either real browser/gateway evidence or an explicit maintainer waiver.

options.title: Reimplement and prove current-main watchdog
options.body: Port the recovery to `ui/src/pages/chat/*`, refresh the PR to a clean merge result, and attach redacted proof showing stale-run recovery, history reload, and queued-message flush.

options.title: Waive proof explicitly
options.body: A maintainer may accept the timer-driven session/message-delivery risk by applying an explicit proof override after reviewing the source and tests.

options.title: Pause this replacement
options.body: Close or pause this stale branch if maintainers prefer a different fix path while keeping the canonical issue open.
